8. In the kitchen of Flat 105, the fixed electrical installations and electrical products were found seriously burnt by fire externally. The fixed electrical installations and electrical products included a ceiling lighting, a range hood, a washing machine, a microwave oven, a distribution board and socket outlets (Photo B1-B9). Other areas of Flat 105 (i.e. Living and Dining Rooms, Bedrooms, CPD, Bathroom) were also affected by fire externally (Photo B10-B14). There was no evidence to show the fire was initiated from fixed electrical installation nor electrical product in Flat 105 and the fire is not electrically related.
